title: Rainshadow - operational warfare themed RTS based in 1885 in Washington Territory
author: Iteration-k
selftext: Here are some screenshots from the game I’m building - Rainshadow. It’s an alternate 1885 in Washington territory where eastern Washington and western Washington go to war. The screenshots are from the free demo I’m planning on releasing in November this year The Battle of Ellensburg featuring Ellensburg, WA and Kittitas valley. Let me know what you think of the HuD, overall visual feel.

comments.author: florodude
comments.body: Gives early 2000s vibe, and I mean that in the best way. What'd you use for engine and models?

replies.author: Iteration-k
replies.body:
That is a HUGE compliment! Empire Earth is my inspiration lol.  
I’m using Unreal Engine 5.7 for the engine. I’m using ai to generate the models, rig them Mixamo, then import them into blender to add weapons, then import back into Mixamo with the weapon attached. Then I get the Mixamo animations

replies.author: florodude
replies.body: Your process for 3d models is very similar to what I've found to be best practice as well. Nice job

replies.author: Iteration-k
replies.body: Thank you dude and thank you for checking out my post. I’ll try to update semi regularly to anyone who is curious

comments.author: wreckmenow
comments.body: Nice! How did you build maps and terrain?

replies.author: Iteration-k
replies.body: I used Unreal Engine for all map building. I used an asset pack from the fab marketplace for my trees
